opening.text: 冬の銭湯の間違い探し、全5問。

unchiku.text: ここでひと休み。こよみ先生の季節のお話です。
銭湯の壁に、富士山の絵が多いのをご存じですか？
100年以上前に、東京で描かれたのが、はじまりといわれています。
大きな富士山をながめると、ほっとしますね。

ending.text: これで5問目まで、おしまいです。
15個の違い、いくつ見つかりましたか。今日の称号です。
チャンネル登録とベルで、毎朝8時半に問題が届きます。毎日の頭の体操にどうぞ。
ほかにも、いろいろな間違い探しがあります。もっと難しい問題に挑戦したい方は、画面の動画をクリックしてくださいね。

extra.text: 見つかった数を、あとでコメントで教えてくださいね。

images.style: A Japanese picture-book illustration in watercolor, but with BOLD, THICK, DARK ink outlines around every object (like a clear picture book for seniors), and CLEAR, SATURATED colors (not pale). Bright, clean background. Natural, hand-drawn, slightly rounded shapes; not geometric, not flat vector, not photorealistic. CLOSE-UP composition (not a wide landscape): the scene is seen from close, filling the picture. PORTRAIT-ISH composition, about 8:9. The painting fills the entire canvas edge to edge: no white border. No people. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere. The MAIN SUBJECT named in the scene is drawn LARGE in the center of the picture. Around it, only a few other objects, each clearly separated with space around it, fully visible.
images.keep_alt: Keep everything else in the picture exactly the same: same composition, same position of every object, same colors, same style. Do not add or remove anything else. Leave no faint outline, ghost or smudge. No text.
images.keep_remove: Where an object is removed, fill the area naturally with what would be behind it, and leave no faint outline, ghost or smudge of the removed object.

questions.prompt: Scene: close-up of the inside of a traditional Japanese public bathhouse (sento) bathing hall on a winter day, bright and clean, light blue and white tiles, soft steam, a small high window showing falling snow. Winter only: no Christmas, New Year's Eve or other dated holiday items, no yuzu, no summer items. Spread the listed objects over the whole picture at the given positions, far apart, never clustered. Keep every listed object BELOW the top fifth and ABOVE the bottom fifth of the picture. Each listed object is fully visible and rests on the floor, a shelf or a counter, or hangs from a hook; nothing floats. Each listed object is about one sixteenth of the picture width, VERY SMALL, with plenty of empty space around it. No letters, labels, numbers or writing anywhere (every tag, curtain, bottle and sign is plain and blank). No people. Do not use much red or orange: keep the light natural daylight and the whites ordinary white; tiles are light blue, white and cream. Objects: (upper left, hanging from a hook on the tiled wall) a small yellow hand towel; (upper right, on a wooden wall shelf) a small wooden bucket; (middle left, on the tile floor) a small round wooden stool; (middle right, on the tile floor) a small yellow rubber duck; (lower left, on the tile floor) a small green plastic wash basin; (lower right, on the tile floor) a small white soap dish with a plain white soap bar.
